provider_observations.spa_source_description: Stanford Phonology Archive inventories derive from Crothers et al. 1979 and were subsequently digitized/mapped to Unicode IPA by PHOIBLE.
provider_observations.ra_source_description: Ramaswami 1999, Common Linguistic Features in Indian Languages: Phonetics; PHOIBLE notes that the source contains inventories compiled from various works and that its ISO codes may be outdated.
provider_observations.upsid_example_source_metadata: A Mundari UPSID value page identifies Gumperz and Bilibiri 1957 and Pinnow 1959 as source references for at least one listed segment.

verification_boundary.reason: PHOIBLE is a secondary compilation and exposes multiple Mundari inventories with differing counts. Inventory-level facts must be resolved to and checked against underlying descriptive sources before controlled promotion.

next_actions: Resolve each candidate Mundari inventory to its cited underlying descriptive source.
Verify bibliographic identity and permitted access for the underlying source before extracting any phonological claim.
Record exact page/section locators and provenance for any promoted inventory statement.
Do not collapse Bhumij-labelled or other doculect records into Mundari without an explicit controlled identity decision.
